### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

🍱 Build model inference APIs and multi-model serving systems with any open-source or custom AI models. 👉 [Join our forum](https://forum.modular.com/c/bento/31)! BentoML is a Python library for building online serving systems optimized for AI apps and model inference. - **🍱 Easily build APIs for Any AI/ML Model.** Turn any model inference script into a REST API server with just a few lines of code and standard Python type hints. - **🐳 Docker Containers made simple.** No more dependency hell! Manage your environments, dependencies and model versions with a simple config file.
